description: Look up what later papers say about a paper, in the citing sentences Cerebrum has collected and classified for it. Returns, for each DOI, whether its sentences are ready, still being collected, or settled empty, the counts by stance, and the sentences themselves, each with two separate labels: the stance Cerebrum assigned and the purpose Semantic Scholar recorded. A paper still being collected is reported as collecting, never as holding nothing.

doi.description: One DOI for the paper to look up. Give either doi or dois, not both.

dois.description: Several DOIs to look up in one call, up to 20. Give either doi or dois, not both.

name: get_statements
title: Citation statements for a paper
